cases.name: CDP profiler schema compatibility
cases.execute: const {startCdpProfiler} = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/profiler.js"); const mockCdp = async (method) => { if(method==="Profiler.enable") return {}; if(method==="Profiler.start") return {}; if(method==="Profiler.stop") return {profile:{nodes:[{id:1,callFrame:{functionName:"test",url:"file:///app.js",lineNumber:1},children:[2]},{id:2,callFrame:{functionName:"helper",url:"file:///util.js",lineNumber:5},children:[]}]}}; if(method==="Profiler.disable") return {}; }; const p = await startCdpProfiler(mockCdp); const trace = await p.stop(); return Array.isArray(trace) && JSON.stringify(trace).includes("fn") && JSON.stringify(trace).includes("file")

cases.name: CDP node schema matches V8 schema
cases.execute: const m = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/profiler.js"); const mockCdp = async (method) => { if(method==="Profiler.stop") return {profile:{nodes:[{id:1,callFrame:{functionName:"root",url:"",lineNumber:0},children:[2]},{id:2,callFrame:{functionName:"fn",url:"file:///app.ts",lineNumber:10},children:[]}]}}; return {}; }; const cdpP = await m.startCdpProfiler(mockCdp); const cdpTrace = await cdpP.stop(); const v8P = await m.startProfiler(); const v8Trace = await v8P.stop(); const hasSameShape = (t) => !t.length || (t[0].fn !== undefined && t[0].file !== undefined && t[0].children !== undefined); return hasSameShape(cdpTrace) && hasSameShape(v8Trace)

cases.name: CDP disconnect error handled
cases.execute: const {startCdpProfiler} = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/profiler.js"); let callCount = 0; const mockCdp = async (method) => { callCount++; if(method==="Profiler.stop") throw new Error("CDP disconnected"); return {}; }; const p = await startCdpProfiler(mockCdp); try { await p.stop(); return false; } catch(e) { return e.message.includes("disconnected"); }
